display_name: Captain Hask at the toll bar
description: P29 (plan M6-M9 §5.7, §5.9): the toll-riders' captain (a talker: protected, never flees) at the toll bar on the King's Road west of the fort, demanding tribute from passers - pay 1 iron, cow him (stage 4) or refuse (dialogue.toll_captain). Not budgeted.
